paragraphs.text: translated by
1. THY spirit, that went far away to Yama to Vivasvan's Son,
paragraphs.original: यत्ते यमं वैवस्वतं मनो जगाम दूरकम् ।
paragraphs.translit: yatte yamaṃ vaivasvataṃ mano jagāma dūrakam |

paragraphs.text: We cause to come to thee again that thou mayst live and sojourn here.
2. Thy spirit, that went far away, that passed away to earth and heaven,
paragraphs.original: यत्ते दिवं यत्पृथिवीं मनो जगाम दूरकम् ।
paragraphs.translit: yatte divaṃ yatpṛthivīṃ mano jagāma dūrakam |

paragraphs.text: We cause to come to thee again that thou mayst live and sojourn here.
3. Thy spirit, that went far away, away to the four-eyed earth,
paragraphs.original: यत्ते भूमिं चतुर्भृष्टिं मनो जगाम दूरकम् ।
paragraphs.translit: yatte bhūmiṃ caturbhṛṣṭiṃ mano jagāma dūrakam |

paragraphs.text: We cause to come to thee again that thou mayst live and sojourn here.
4. Thy spirit, that went far away to the four quarters of the world,
paragraphs.original: यत्ते चतस्रः प्रदिशो मनो जगाम दूरकम् ।
paragraphs.translit: yatte catasraḥ pradiśo mano jagāma dūrakam |

paragraphs.text: We cause to come to thee again that thou mayst live and sojourn here.
5. Thy spirit, that went far away, away unto the billowy sea,
We cause to come to thee again that thou mayst live and sojourn here.
6. Thy spirit, that went far away to beams of light that flash and flow,
paragraphs.original: यत्ते मरीचीः प्रवतो मनो जगाम दूरकम् ।
paragraphs.translit: yatte marīcīḥ pravato mano jagāma dūrakam |

paragraphs.text: We cause to come to thee again that thou mayst live and sojourn here.
7. Thy spirit, that went far away, went to the waters and the plants,
We cause to come to thee again that thou mayst live and sojourn here.
8. Thy spirit, that went far away, that visited the Sun and Dawn.
paragraphs.original: यत्ते सूर्यं यदुषसं मनो जगाम दूरकम् ।
paragraphs.translit: yatte sūryaṃ yaduṣasaṃ mano jagāma dūrakam |

paragraphs.text: We cause to come to thee again that thou mayst live and sojourn here.
9. Thy spirit, that went far away, away to lofty mountain heights,
We cause to come to thee again that thou mayst live and sojourn here.
10. Thy spirit, that went far away into this All, that lives and moves,
We cause to come to thee again that thou mayst live and sojourn here.
11. Thy spirit, that went far away to distant realms beyond our ken,
paragraphs.original: यत्ते पराः परावतो मनो जगाम दूरकम् ।
paragraphs.translit: yatte parāḥ parāvato mano jagāma dūrakam |

paragraphs.text: We cause to come to thee again that thou mayst live and sojourn here.
12. Thy spirit, that went far away to all that is and is to be,
paragraphs.original: यत्ते भूतं च भव्यं च मनो जगाम दूरकम् ।
paragraphs.translit: yatte bhūtaṃ ca bhavyaṃ ca mano jagāma dūrakam |

paragraphs.text: We cause to come to thee again that thou mayst live and sojourn here.
